evidence: The solutions uniformly use BFS/DFS two-coloring: "color[v] = color[u] ^ 1", "Check if bipartite using BFS", and assigning an opposite color to every adjacent vertex.
affordance_in_statement: The factory now runs only two shifts, labeled 1 and 2. Furthermore, no conflicting pair may share a shift.
removal_suggestion: There is no meaningful way to remove this cue without changing the task's intrinsic structure: assigning one of two labels to endpoints of every conflict edge is exactly bipartite checking.
